{{Top|leg}}
'''Infrared Cyber-Optics''' was a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] implant. The implant allowed the individual to see in dark and obscured visual conditions. [[Howzmin]], security [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] to [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], had Infrared Cyber-Optics installed.
